title: SIMINTERVIEW: TRANSFORMING BUSINESS EDUCA TION THROUGH LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL-BASED SIMULATED MULTILINGUAL INTERVIEW TRAINING SYSTEM
reasoning: The paper focuses on a simulated interview system for business education and evaluates its performance through alignment and content preservation metrics. While it discusses bias mitigation and ethical design principles (contestable AI) to meet regulatory requirements like the EU AI Act, it does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religious beliefs, moral dilemmas, or ethical frameworks.
